# SKOS Vocabulary

> An RDF vocabulary for describing the basic structure and content of concept schemes such as thesauri, classification schemes, subject heading lists, taxonomies, 'folksonomies', other types of controlled vocabulary, and also concept schemes embedded in glossaries and terminologies.

- Ontology IRI: http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core
- Namespace: http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core# (prefix `skos:`)
- Contents: 4 classes, 17 object properties, 1 datatype property, 18 annotation properties

Terms are identified by IRI; use the CURIEs and labels below when writing SPARQL or RDF.

## Documentation

- [Overview](index.md): metadata and contents
- [Classes](classes.md): 4 classes with definitions and axioms
- [Object properties](object-properties.md): 17 object properties with definitions and axioms
- [Datatype properties](datatype-properties.md): 1 datatype property with definitions and axioms
- [Annotation properties](annotation-properties.md): 18 annotation properties with definitions and axioms

## Machine-readable

- [ontology.json](ontology.json): all terms as JSON (IRI, label, definition, hierarchy, domain/range)
- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt): the complete documentation as one Markdown file
- [Turtle](ontology.ttl): the ontology source (text/turtle)
- [RDF/XML](ontology.owl): the ontology source (application/rdf+xml)
- [JSON-LD](ontology.jsonld): the ontology source (application/ld+json)
- [N-Triples](ontology.nt): the ontology source (application/n-triples)
